name: Med Mapped
tagline: The road to med school, mapped out by a first-year med student
author: Dylan
author_bio: I'm Dylan, a first-year med student. I'm mapping out the road I just traveled: real deadlines, real costs, and free printables to keep it all in one place.

atlas.name: MD Atlas
atlas.blurb: My free app for the whole med school application: a weekly planner that totals your hours, an activity log with the AMCAS character limits, a secondaries tracker with prompts for 150+ programs, and an interview tracker.

primary.title: Log activities as you go
primary.text: MD Atlas has a free activity log: hours, dates and a contact for each one, plus Work and Activities drafts with the AMCAS character limits counted as you type. No account needed.

secondaries.title: See which schools ask what
secondaries.text: MD Atlas, my free app, lists the reported secondary prompts for 150+ MD programs, searchable by school and prompt type, so you can see which prompts repeat across your list and pre-write once. Prompts are labeled when they aren't confirmed by the school, so always check your actual secondary.

planner.title: Plan your week, count your hours
planner.text: MD Atlas has a free weekly planner that adds up your clinical, research and volunteer hours as you go, so the numbers are ready when AMCAS asks.

med-tracker.title: Med School Application Command Center
med-tracker.blurb: School list, AMCAS and secondary fees, essays, interviews and offers in one spreadsheet.

residency-tracker.title: Residency Application Tracker (ERAS)
residency-tracker.blurb: Programs, ERAS fees, letters, interviews and your rank list in one spreadsheet.

pa-tracker.title: PA School Application Tracker (CASPA)
pa-tracker.blurb: Programs, CASPA fees, patient care hours and interviews in one spreadsheet.

dental-tracker.title: Dental School Application Tracker (AADSAS)
dental-tracker.blurb: Schools, AADSAS fees, shadowing hours and interviews in one spreadsheet.

vet-tracker.title: Vet School Application Tracker (VMCAS)
vet-tracker.blurb: Schools, VMCAS fees, animal and vet hours and interviews in one spreadsheet.

grad-tracker.title: Grad School Application Tracker
grad-tracker.blurb: Programs, fees, recommenders, statements and funding in one spreadsheet.
